title: Shift compatibility of the compact-support restriction square
statement: For a finite coefficient change a and compactification c of f, the hom of restriction a c commutes with the canonical integer shifts.

source.place: Tag 07A6, derived adjunction mates and shift compatibility
source.note: This is the lower restriction-square step used by the coefficient comparison mate.

proof.text: The open restriction comparison and the proper direct-image restriction comparison each commute with shifts by their normalized derived adjunction constructions. Pasting their natural shift equations gives the hom of restriction a c.

source.note: The statement is isolated as a lower proof step for the parent coefficient comparison.

lean.statement:
theorem restriction_commShift {R S : Coefficients.{u}} (a : Change R S)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y} (c : Compactification f)
    [hRX : (pbcDerivedRestrict (a.map X)).CommShift ℤ]
    [hIR : (image R c).CommShift ℤ]
    [hIS : (image S c).CommShift ℤ]
    [hRY : (pbcDerivedRestrict (a.map Y)).CommShift ℤ] :
    NatTrans.CommShift (restriction a c).hom ℤ
